remarks: LOCATION LOCATION LOCATION! Welcome to 45 June Ave, a newly renovated conventional-style single-family located in the charming community of Norwalk! This well-appointed 4 bedroom, 2 bathroom house has 1,500 SqFt of comfortable living space with an ADDITIONAL 400 SqFt of finished basement. Step inside to find a warm and welcoming atmosphere, featuring an open-concept living room that flows seamlessly into a spacious dining area; ideal for entertaining guests or enjoying family meals. The kitchen has stainless steel appliances and ample counter space, making it a joy to cook and gather. Enjoy your privacy with a completely fenced-in yard providing a lovely space for outdoor activities, gardening, or simply relaxing in the sun. Enjoy the convenience of a private driveway and a garage, offering extra storage and parking space. Located just a short stroll from Kendall Elementary School and Ponus Ridge Middle School, this home is perfect for families with kids. The neighborhood has a vibrant community atmosphere, with nearby parks and shopping centers including SoNo Collection mall, which is only a 5-minute drive away. Come discover everything about this charming house and let's make it your next HOME!
